_note: Pinned negative claims: promises whose truth-maker is that NO CODE EXISTS. Nothing in the tree can be coupled to them (there is no telemetry module to map a document onto - the whole claim is that there isn't one), so the doc-sync hook and check-doc-map-paths are structurally blind to them and always will be. They rot two ways, neither of which produces a diff any doc gate routes: somebody builds the thing, or somebody deletes the sentence in a rewrite. This file pins the wording; check-promise-pins.mjs enforces it. A pin proves a promise is still STATED, never that it is TRUE - so every entry carries the date a human established its truth and the wording that review approved.

pins.reason: The product's central user-facing commitment. Entirely negative, so no source area exists to couple it to. Lives in exactly ONE document today, which is itself the finding: one edit removes the whole privacy commitment and every gate stays green.
required: never leave your machine unless you explicitly send them
The only outbound traffic goes to the AI providers and third-party services you configure

forbidden._note: The dual sweep: phrasings a pinned promise rules out. A floor, extended on every escape - never narrowed to make a document pass.
